statement: This addendum was written after the original delay test had been run and had failed. It replaces that test; it does not change rules R1-R4 or any feature.

original_delay_test.label: MIS-SPECIFIED (retained; result unchanged)
original_delay_test.definition: Shift every bar-level input of each session one slot later and require every detector feature at slot s+1 to equal the original at slot s.

diagnosis.finding: every mismatch is at a known clock-position edge row; no value leaked

why_mis_specified: R1 concerns when a value becomes available, not what its value is. A delay moves availability; it does not move a feature to a different bar. The test checked shift-equivariance of data content, which R1 does not require.
The frozen definitions are clock-position rules (slot >= W), so shifting content one slot fails at the first computable row of the partial90 outputs by design.
The shift drops the last bar of each session, so the relative-volume baseline changes at the slot after an early close ends.

replacement_delay_test.definition: Add an extra 1-minute delay: every bar becomes available at t+2 minutes instead of t+1. Then (V) all 80 detector feature values, NaN pattern included, are identical to the undelayed run; (A) the available_at of every finite feature value equals t+2 minutes; (P) in a point-in-time replay, at decision time t+2 minutes the features computed from only the visible bars equal the full-run value at row t, and at decision time t+1 minute row t is not yet visible.
replacement_delay_test.available_at_definition: available_at of a feature row stamped t is the availability of bar t, the newest bar it may read (R1: no output reads a later bar).
datasets: RAW slice of 40 sessions including the 2022-11-25 early close
replacement_delay_test.replay: 3 decision rows per dataset, slot >= 70 and session >= 12; features recomputed from only the rows with available <= decision time
replacement_delay_test.tolerance: V exact (NaN equals NaN); P rtol 1e-9, atol 0

unchanged: the 80 detector outputs and overnight_return_open exclusion (A2)
